howToPlay: Use the basic attack to chip away at enemies with bouncing stones. Deploy the Super to close the distance or reposition while inside the Driller to access a new powerful attack.
gears: Equip the DAMAGE gear to maximize offensive output and the GADGET COOLDOWN gear to use gadgets more frequently for better map control.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy aggressive playstyles that combine mobile combat with area denial.
